welcome_p1: Navia is a map you explore by touch. Slide a finger over the map and you hear the streets, shops, bus stops and crossings under it.
welcome_p2: Navia is an extra aid only. Always use your cane, guide dog or other safe method first.

ios_intro: On iPhone and iPad, in Safari:
ios_1: Choose the Share button. It is in the toolbar at the bottom of the screen (on iPad at the top).
ios_2: In the list, choose “Add to Home Screen”. You may need to scroll down or choose “More” first.
ios_note: Navia then opens from the home screen like an app, without the browser bars.
and_1: Choose “More options”, the menu button at the top right.
and_2: Choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”, then “Install”.
and_note: In Samsung Internet: Menu, then “Add page to”, then “Home screen”. In Firefox: Menu, then “Install”.
share_msg: Would you like to share Navia Web with others? You can send the link by email, WhatsApp or any other app, to a friend, a family member, or anyone who could use a map they can touch and hear.
help_1: Slide one finger over the map. You hear what is under it. With a screen reader, the map is read as you explore by touch.
help_2: Double-tap a place (screen reader) or touch and hold it (no screen reader) to aim at it, hear its sounds or center the map there.
help_3: Use North, South, West and East to move the map, and Zoom to see more or less.
help_4: Without a screen reader you can also move the map with two fingers and pinch to zoom.
help_5: Directions are given as clock positions: 12 o'clock is straight ahead, or north when no compass is available.
help_6: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Navia is an extra aid only.
